fusions.name: Gallop Clamp
fusions.desc: You charge to the target and snap shut on it for 14 damage, pinning it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hoofprint
fusions.desc: A thrown jaw that deals 5 damage, up to 1.4 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Untiring Pace
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Second Wind Spring
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you restore 6 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
